items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: So I’ve been making a habit of going to Chicago maybe once a year, and on Monday or Tuesday are the only nights he plays, I go out to Toulouse and see him, and he always has me play one tune and makes a big fuss about it.

ctx.x: I met him purely by chance too at one of the Gibson parties. I was wandering around looking for musicians to talk to, so my wife was minding her business and sat in the chair. And it was the empty chair beside her and Johnny Fregal came around and said “is this an empty seat, my wife is looking for a seat, could she sit with you?” And she said “yes, certainly she can.” And so then when I came back, whatever, she said “this is the wife of that Johnny Fregal that you saw” and I admired him because he played like…
plays so good. It’s not. It’s like a plumber taking out your appendix again. But Fregel’s been a wonderful person.
